description: This Dart source file defines data models and a provider class related to attendance reporting, specifically for daily and weekly summaries. It includes classes for report data structures, a provider for fetching and listening for real-time updates, and integrations with API and real-time services.

classes.name: DailySummary
classes.description: Immutable model representing a daily attendance summary, including date key and counts of present, absent, late, and excused students.

classes.name: WeeklySummary
classes.description: Model representing a weekly attendance summary starting from a specific week start date, including total counts.

classes.name: ReportProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier provider that manages fetching, updating, and listening for real-time updates of daily and weekly reports, with support for mock mode.

methods.name: DailySummary.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create DailySummary from a JSON map.

methods.name: DailySummary.toJson
methods.description: Converts DailySummary instance into JSON map.

methods.name: WeeklySummary.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create WeeklySummary from a JSON map.

methods.name: WeeklySummary.toJson
methods.description: Converts WeeklySummary instance into JSON map.

methods.name: ReportProvider.fetchDaily
methods.description: Fetches daily report data for a specific date, either from API or mock data.

methods.name: ReportProvider.fetchWeekly
methods.description: Fetches weekly report data starting from a specific week, either from API or mock data.

methods.name: ReportProvider._handleRealtime
methods.description: Handles incoming real-time messages to update report data accordingly.
